info.title: Recoup API - Uploads
info.description: Authenticated public file uploads. This is not private file or release-pack audio storage.

post.description:
Upload one file of at most 4 MiB (4,194,304 bytes) to public Supabase Storage. Authenticate with exactly one x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer credential for an existing Recoup account; authentication precedes multipart parsing. The uploader is derived from that account and recorded as uploaded_by metadata, never a client-supplied account override.

The returned URL is public: anyone with it can read the file without authentication. Use only content intended for public access. This replaces the public upload destination; it does not move private user-files, release-pack source audio, or existing files. Previously issued Arweave URLs remain readable; no new Arweave write is part of this operation.

Send multipart/form-data with exactly one file field and let your HTTP client set the multipart boundary. Supported MIME types are `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`, `application/pdf`, `text/csv`, `text/markdown`, `text/x-markdown`, `text/plain`, `application/json`, `audio/mpeg`, `audio/wav`, `audio/x-m4a`, `audio/webm`. The server checks binary signatures, UTF-8 text and JSON syntax as appropriate; a filename extension or MIME declaration alone does not establish a valid file. HTML, SVG, executable files and unspecified binary types are not supported. The streamed request body is limited to 4,259,840 bytes (4 MiB plus 64 KiB); the file itself remains limited to 4 MiB.

200.description: The file was stored in public Supabase Storage. The returned URL does not require authentication to read.

400.description: Invalid multipart request (including a non-multipart Content-Type), missing file, empty file, or unsupported form fields. Submit exactly one nonempty file field.

401.description: Missing, invalid or conflicting credentials, or no existing account for the credential. Authentication is checked before multipart parsing.

413.description: The file exceeds 4 MiB (4,194,304 bytes), or the full streamed request exceeds 4,259,840 bytes (4 MiB plus 64 KiB of multipart overhead).

415.description: Unsupported file MIME type, mismatched binary signature, invalid UTF-8 text, or invalid JSON.

500.description: Upload failed. The response does not expose storage-provider details.

file.description: Exactly one nonempty file, at most 4 MiB (4,194,304 bytes). The MIME type must be supported; filename extensions do not override validation.

fileType.description: Accepted MIME type of the uploaded file.

url.description: Public Supabase Storage URL. Anyone with this URL can read the object without authentication; this is not a signed private URL.

error.description: Human-readable error. Storage-provider details are not returned.
